scheme_name: Scheme of Assistance for Environment Protection Measures: Scheme for assistance to encouraging Green Practices and Environmental Audit to MSMEs
other_conditions: Must be registered under relevant industrial laws in Gujarat
Must comply with existing environmental regulations and standards
Must be engaged in manufacturing or production activities
Must undertake projects focused on environmental protection measures
Must adopt green practices as specified in the scheme
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering up to 75% of environmental audit fees (capped at ₹50,000) and up to 25‑35% of fees for monitoring systems, green building certification, EMS, equipment purchase, and wastewater recovery, subject to specified ceilings.
